Reserving your bay or court in advance is strongly suggested to secure your preferred time and avoid long waits. Walk-ins are welcome, but reserving in advance will save you time at check in!

faq.q: What do I pay when booking in advance?
faq.a: When booking in advance, you will pay half of costs upfront, including a processing fee and $5 membership fee if it is your first time at T-Shotz.

faq.q: How many people fit in a bay?
faq.a: Our 61 climate controlled hitting bays accommodate up to 8 people. Complimentary clubs are available.

faq.q: How do I book an event?
faq.a: Contact our event sales team at tshotz.com/contact-sales-team or email sales@tshotz.com, or call (816) 702-1320.

faq.q: Can I get a private bar for my event?
faq.a: Yes. The Main Bar/Restaurant, the Top Bar, and the Banquet Room all offer private bar access.
